entities.summary:
Myanmar International Terminals Thilawa, also known as the Yangon Port International Terminal or Thilawa Port, is a deep river port on the Yangon River, 
16 kilometres (9.9 mi) south of downtown Yangon in Myanmar. Thilawa Port is the largest port terminal in Myanmar and, alongside the Port of Yangon, is one of the two main ports of Yangon.
